raw_source.title: New Opportunity at Kongregate [Remote-Full Time Position]
raw_source.body:
Hi everyone,

I’m reaching out regarding an **Engineering Team Lead** opportunity at **Kongregate** (https://kongregate.com, https://linkedin.com/company/kongregate) for experienced software engineers with strong technical leadership backgrounds.

We’re looking for someone who can:

- Lead and mentor engineering teams
- Drive technical design and implementation
- Review architecture and code
- Coordinate engineering delivery
- Work closely with product and technical leadership
- Contribute to gaming and Web3-related initiatives

Candidates with experience in game development, backend/full-stack engineering, Web3/blockchain, scalable systems, or technical leadership may be particularly relevant.

The salary range is **$165,000 – $215,000 USD / year**.

If you're interested, please feel free to contact me privately with your CV/LinkedIn profile and a brief overview of your relevant experience.

whatsapp: +1 (309) 501-9362
telegram: @gabrielexman

Best regards,
_Kongregate_
